scope: Final SysML 2.0 recognition productions and original synthesis actions; no corpus compatibility alternatives adopted.
projection_contract: Assignments, cross-reference brackets and object-creation actions do not consume source text; raw actions remain available for canonical lowering.
Header colon/equals layout is normalized. The unclosed individual/at terminal quotes are delimited using the final reserved keyword list, without changing source tokens or production alternatives.
The printed -> lookahead marker in PayloadFeatureSpecializationPart is a grammar guard, not the quoted source token. Recognition still requires FeatureSpecialization; raw notation is retained.
Undefined printed nonterminals have no alternatives and cannot match; no sentinel is accepted from source.
DefinitionElement, CaseBodyItem, OccurrenceUsagePrefix, DefaultReferenceUsage and SatisfyRequirementUsage retain the strict printed alternatives; four pending corpus interpretations are not adopted.
